opportunities.name: City weekend trip planning and email summary
opportunities.description: For a given city and dates, gather population (Wikipedia), weather (timeanddate), hotel (Booking), activities (Viator), dinner (OpenTable-like site), save a note and draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, co (restaurant booking), notes, mail
steps: Search city on Wikipedia and read population
Search city on timeanddate and read the weather/temperature
On Booking, enter the destination, select check-in and check-out dates, set travelers if needed, and search
Open a hotel and view its info and price
On Viator, search for activity 1 in the city and open a result
On Viator, search for activity 2 in the city and open a result
On the restaurant site, search for city plus cuisine, pick the date, find a table, and open a restaurant
In Notes, write a summary note with city, dates, population, temperature, hotel, activities and dinner
In Mail, compose a message to the friend with the subject and body plan

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search for destination and dates
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com for a destination with given dates and guest count, then open a hotel's info and prices.
steps: Clear or click the destination field
Type destination and choose the option
Open date picker and select check-in and check-out
Open a hotel result and click Info & prices
